name: patorsiang-portfolio-monorepo

scripts.//typecheck: --filter '*' runs the typecheck script of EVERY workspace that has one, and exits non-zero if any fails. Do NOT narrow this back to one --cwd: until 2026-09-20 it read '--cwd apps/portfolio-web', which meant a type error anywhere in packages/ passed both the pre-commit hook and this repo's required CI check. A workspace with TypeScript and no typecheck script is still invisible here.
scripts.//security:audit: The --ignore list is the accepted-risk register. Every ID here is justified in docs/architecture/code-quality.md > Accepted dependency risks. Do NOT append an ID without adding its entry there.

//lint-staged: --check, NOT --write. prettier --write repairs the file, re-stages it and lets the commit through, which makes this tier a fixer -- and R2 in flow.md calls the pre-commit tier a local gate in writing. Chosen 2026-09-20 with the cost accepted: a badly formatted file now fails the commit, and you run 'bun run format' and stage again. That is what it costs for the step to be able to stop you.
